Fourteen Tuesdays, 14:00–17:15, 15 September to 15 December 2026, at Unitobler,
Lerchenweg 36, Room F-123. The Lab **starts at 14:00 sharp** — not a quarter past.

::: {.callout-note title="Bring your laptop"}
From [Session 2](/contents/sessions/02.qmd) onwards every session is hands-on on your own
machine. Materials, datasets and anything that cannot be published openly are in the [ILIAS
course
space](https://ilias.unibe.ch/ilias.php?baseClass=ilrepositorygui&cmdNode=yv:ng&cmdClass=ilObjCourseGUI&ref_id=3733960).
:::

## Sessions

### [Session 1](/contents/sessions/01.qmd) (15 September 2026)

**Programme information · Introductions · Individual consultations** [Course team]{.teach .teach-team}

Information on the MA Major, MA Minor and the doctoral track; introductions; consultation slots.
Prepare an answer to the orientation questions on the [session
page](/contents/sessions/01.qmd).

*In the Intro:* [Welcome · What is
DH](https://dhbern.github.io/introduction-to-dh/contents/sessions/01.html)

### [Session 2](/contents/sessions/02.qmd) (22 September 2026)

**Get to know your computer** [Demleitner]{.teach .teach-demleitner}

Command line · paths · data storage · file naming conventions.

*In the Intro:* [What is DH? · What is
data?](https://dhbern.github.io/introduction-to-dh/contents/sessions/02.html)

### [Session 3](/contents/sessions/03.qmd) (29 September 2026)

**Get to know useful stuff** [Hodel]{.teach .teach-hodel}

[Markdown](https://docs.github.com/en/get-started/writing-on-github/getting-started-with-writing-and-formatting-on-github/basic-writing-and-formatting-syntax)
· [Obsidian](https://obsidian.md/) · [GitHub](https://github.com/) ·
[VSCodium](https://vscodium.com/).

**16:00 — Final-year meeting (I): report on projects.**

*In the Intro:* [Forms of data and
metadata](https://dhbern.github.io/introduction-to-dh/contents/sessions/03.html)

### [Session 4](/contents/sessions/04.qmd) (6 October 2026)

**Replacing Excel with SQLite for data management** [Beretta]{.teach .teach-beretta}

Data modelling in practice: [draw.io](https://app.diagrams.net/) ·
[SQLite](https://www.sqlite.org/) ·
[QuickDBD](https://app.quickdatabasediagrams.com/).

*In the Intro:* [Data
structures](https://dhbern.github.io/introduction-to-dh/contents/sessions/04.html)

### [Session 5](/contents/sessions/05.qmd) (13 October 2026)

**From Linked Open Data to RiC-O, LRM and CIDOC-CRM** [Hart]{.teach .teach-hart}

The formal ontologies of archives, libraries and museums.

*In the Intro:* [Data modelling: Linked Open
Data](https://dhbern.github.io/introduction-to-dh/contents/sessions/05.html)

### [Session 6](/contents/sessions/06.qmd) (20 October 2026)

**Introduction to APIs** [Hodel]{.teach .teach-hodel}

Calling the Zotero API, including token setup · APIs of cultural heritage institutions
([examples](https://pad.dsl.unibe.ch/p/resed-api-20260129#/)).

*In the Intro:* [Data publication: the web as
interface](https://dhbern.github.io/introduction-to-dh/contents/sessions/06.html)

### [Session 7](/contents/sessions/07.qmd) (27 October 2026)

**Introduction to scholarly editing as a form of data publication** [Spadini]{.teach .teach-spadini}

TEI, hands-on: encoding, validating, transforming, publishing.

*In the Intro:* [Data modelling:
editions](https://dhbern.github.io/introduction-to-dh/contents/sessions/07.html)

### [Session 8](/contents/sessions/08.qmd) (3 November 2026)

**Introduction to Omeka** [Hodel]{.teach .teach-hodel}

Data standards · controlled vocabularies · the API · what to use when: GitHub Pages or Omeka.

**16:00 — Final-year meeting (II): report on status.**

*In the Intro:* [Data analysis:
networks](https://dhbern.github.io/introduction-to-dh/contents/sessions/08.html)

### [Session 9](/contents/sessions/09.qmd) (10 November 2026)

**Introduction to Colab / Noto** [Hodel]{.teach .teach-hodel}

Notebooks · enough Python to adapt an analysis · topic modelling.

*In the Intro:* [Data analysis: text
corpora](https://dhbern.github.io/introduction-to-dh/contents/sessions/09.html)

### [Session 10](/contents/sessions/10.qmd) (17 November 2026)

**Data cleaning and connecting: OpenRefine** [Demleitner]{.teach .teach-demleitner}

Clustering · GREL · reconciliation against Wikidata, hands-on.

*In the Intro:*
[Geovisualisation](https://dhbern.github.io/introduction-to-dh/contents/sessions/10.html)

### [Session 11](/contents/sessions/11.qmd) (24 November 2026)

**Text recognition: introduction to eScriptorium** [Hodel]{.teach .teach-hodel}

Segmentation · transcription · ground truth · training and evaluation, hands-on.

*In the Intro:* [From algorithms to machine
learning](https://dhbern.github.io/introduction-to-dh/contents/sessions/11.html)

### [Session 12](/contents/sessions/12.qmd) (1 December 2026)

**GenAI in action: multimodal LLMs in the humanities** [Prada Ziegler]{.teach .teach-prada}

Transcription, extraction, classification — and how to check any of it.

*In the Intro:* [LLMs: stochastic parrots and research
agents](https://dhbern.github.io/introduction-to-dh/contents/sessions/12.html)

### [Session 13](/contents/sessions/13.qmd) (8 December 2026)

**Workflow presentations** [Course team]{.teach .teach-team}

Everyone presents their workflow; structured feedback from the group.

*In the Intro:* [Data
feminism](https://dhbern.github.io/introduction-to-dh/contents/sessions/13.html)

### [Session 14](/contents/sessions/14.qmd) (15 December 2026)

**Presentations: Master Minor and Master Major** [Course team]{.teach .teach-team}

Final-year presentations; for Major students a test run for the defence.

*In the Intro:* [FAIR, CARE and digital
sustainability](https://dhbern.github.io/introduction-to-dh/contents/sessions/14.html)
